name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.PadSlots.point_complement_cover_card
title: Covering all of {0,1}^n except one point p by subcubes that avoid p needs at least n subcubes, so cube-shaped pad slots cannot be fewer than n at the last point insertion
statement: Let C : ι → Fin n → Option Bool describe subcubes (x is in cube j iff for every i, C j i = none or C j i = some (x i)). If no cube contains p and every x ≠ p lies in some cube, then n ≤ Fintype.card ι.
